How a small addition keeps adding up

ILLUSTRATIVE MODEL

Set up a session

A model request is one inference call. One user message can trigger many requests. Growth represents prior outputs, tool results, and new inputs retained for later requests.

Input carried across requests

Original context After removing noise

Total input exposure

Exposure avoided

Formula & assumptions

Total = N × B + G × N × (N − 1) / 2
Avoided = N × removable starting tokens

No compaction, eviction, truncation, caching discounts, output billing, or context-window ceiling is modeled. Exposure is the sum of input tokens across requests, not the size of one window or a bill. Real harnesses manage context.

    Evidence boundaries

    This site does not inspect your machine, billing, prompts, or logs. Audit answers are self-reported and kept in memory until the page is reloaded. “Unknown” is distinct from “Green.” Recommendations and severity are editorial judgments. Calculator results are hypothetical.

    Token shares are not dollar shares. Cache reads, writes, new input, output, and reasoning can carry different rates. API billing documentation does not establish ChatGPT or Codex subscription accounting. Personal usage percentages, fixed connector token sizes, and multipliers are not universal benchmarks.

    Ask your agent for a measured audit

    This seven-part audit separates measured facts from estimates, protects credentials, and checks product-specific behavior. Select your environment above.

    How this audit handles evidence

    The audit records version and authentication mode, deduplication of log events, separate input/cache/output accounting, capability limits for ChatGPT, and privacy boundaries. It avoids automatic cost rankings without rates, universal cache-reset claims, arbitrary instruction thresholds, and the assumption that a schedule longer than TTL always misses cache. Gateway detection now distinguishes presence, fallback, explicit overrides, and provider support.
